Order 
First bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) in connection with Crime No.686 of 2023, Police Station City Kotwali, District- Satna (M.P) registered under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 386, 419 and 506 of IPC.

Applicant is in custody since 16.10.2024.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant and the victim were acquainted with each other through Facebook ID and they were consented relations as the victim was major and of 29 years and the applicant was 28 years.
They were having relations since November, 2022.
On 07.08.2023 the family members of the victim saw the applicant in their home and thereafter a report was lodged.
The applicant has not personated himself as a Military Personnel.
Report is false.
Hence the applicant may be released on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that the applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:1018 2 MCRC-52360-2024 personating himself as a Army Personnel cheated the victim and obtained the consent by applying fraud, therefore, the bail application be dismissed.
4. Heard the parties and and I have gone through the case diary.

Looking to the fact and circumstances of the case and the applicant is in judicial custody since 16.10.2024, without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

5. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the Kapilesh Tiwari vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135588898/
1 satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
